title: Create a Btrfs subvolume
summary: Create a new subvolume within a mounted Btrfs file system. Subvolumes act like separate directories or partitions.

steps.explain: Create a new subvolume at the specified path. Replace <SUBVOL_PATH> with the desired location (e.g., /mnt/btrfs/home).

placeholders.name: SUBVOL_PATH
placeholders.description: Full path where the subvolume should be created
